text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Trainer-san!
Welcome back, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As the main attraction of the Holy Hoof Festival, the Umamusume Maid Café has drawn massive lines right from opening.
At a glance, everything seems to be sailing smoothly without trouble, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The time: a few hours earlier.
A heavy atmosphere hung over the student council room.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —I have confirmed a shop in Tokyo selling butler costumes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, the earliest we can arrive is noon.
We won't make it in time for the store opening.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Thank you for your swift response.
However... noon, is it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry,
it's all because I took my eyes off for a second...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"It was just an accident, no need to worry.
Nobody could have expected the whole box of costumes
to be collected as trash."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...However, we must come up with a plan.
It would be rather tough to call it a butler café
without any butler costumes."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...We're running out of time.
Opening this morning is simply—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The student council room fell dead silent.
And right then—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! I have heard, everyone!
What an utterly unexpected accident!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, would my beauty be swayed
by mere clothing? Nay! It matters not!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because the one everyone
is waiting for is ME!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Please, I'm asking you too! Not opening the shop
is just wrong when everyone's looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "The one waiting is me"...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know!
Um, what do you think about trying a method like this—

text_block_list.name: Visitor A
text_block_list.text: When the concept was suddenly changed to an 'Umamusume Café' where people become Trainers and enjoy daily life with Umamusume, I was honestly a bit bewildered at first, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Before starting today's work...
Here, have a cup of blended coffee, Trainer-kun."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt your meal.
What should we do about today's training?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you've come to watch every single one of my races?!
That's amazing! Thank you~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—No, wait! I mean, you're my Trainer,
so that's only natural, right?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A photo? But of course!
It would be a waste of beauty to keep it solely within our eyes!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's move over to the sunny window!

text_block_list.name: Visitor A
text_block_list.text: This is good in its own way...!

text_block_list.name: Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
And from the afternoon, it's the butler café as scheduled, right!?
I've gotta come back for that!

text_block_list.name: Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wait,
aren't the reservations already fully booked—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry! We added more seating, so there's plenty of room.
Should I go ahead and make a reservation for you?

text_block_list.name: Visitor A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Well then, I'll see you in the afternoon.
Next time, as your loyal butler!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Please look forward to it, Milady.

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah~~!!
